problem: What enhancements/improvements would most improve agent-ee as a useful, trustworthy electronics engineering review and repair tool? (preserving: one implementation writer, immutable candidate/requirements, independent initial reviewers, centralized evidence-backed adjudication, bounded convergence, bench feedback)

ideas.text: Poison-pill library audit: standing self-test canaries over the capture boundary (corrupted symbol/footprint fixtures must be flagged)
Unfalsifiable-requirement detector: find baseline requirements no declared check can ever fail; demand a real check or explicit waiver
Reviewer-collusion fingerprinting: flag statistically improbable agreement (shared phrasing/citation order) as loss-of-independence
Metric-gaming detector: margin gains must trace to design changes, not parser tolerances or measurement-window artifacts
Bench forgery resistance: residual envelopes re-derived from raw instrument capture files, not operator-typed summaries
Evidence-consumption coverage gate: disposition built on unread packet regions is incomplete review
ideas.trap: attention tracking from harness logs is unreliable; as a hard gate it fails runs on instrumentation noise — viable only as an advisory metric

ideas.text: Pre-flight quota canary call per harness before launching a reviewer wave
Campaign coroner subcommand: replay the hash chain after any failure; print which phase died, what evidence is valid, the single safe next action
Reviewer liveness heartbeats with automatic kill-and-replace of a wedged reviewer
ideas.trap: automatic replacement is a retry by another name; violates the deliberate no-retry/fail-closed provider policy

ideas.text: Staleness tripwires: re-verify runtime/library fingerprints immediately before each expensive phase, refusing before quota is spent
Refusal explainer: map every refusal to the policy clause, exact hash mismatch and one-line remediation
Budget-aware sealed partial verdict that later runs can resume from
ideas.trap: reusing partial evidence undermines the freshness-by-rerun principle; viable only as a notarized report, not as resumable acceptance

ideas.text: Customs lanes: risk-routed review depth per campaign iteration (checks-only while checks fail; full adversarial review for acceptance candidates) with mandatory random full inspections
Defect depot: failed iterations retained as sealed negative-example packets consulted by the implementation agent (not initial reviewers)
Cold-chain custody for bench evidence: calibration-expiry and attestation-chain records; a cold-chain break quarantines the residual envelope
Cross-docking: dedupe expensive extractions across checks/reviewers with hashed dock manifests
ideas.trap: premature optimization: extractions cost seconds while the dedup adds real trust-chain complexity

ideas.text: Signature-on-delivery: engineer must acknowledge each adjudicated defect at its schematic/board location before a campaign consumes it
Requirement waybills: per-reviewer requirement-coverage attestations whose union must cover the baseline
Replay ghosts: render campaign margin trajectories against prior campaigns so pacing is legible
Pre-registered operator predictions before unsealing adjudication, with a scored calibration ledger (measures what the tool catches that the engineer missed)
Trade-off decision screen: escalation rendered as curated live tensions with evidence chains and explicit spend options
Campaign forks: named alternate lines from any sealed iteration, with side-by-side margin/defect history diffs
Defect bestiary: named cross-project defect classes seeded to reviewers as hunting lenses
New-game-plus onboarding: graded library of deliberately broken reference boards with sealed ground truth for trust calibration
Thymic negative selection: score reviewer false-positive rates on seeded known-good designs per epoch
ideas.trap: auto-pruning reviewers is model substitution, which the explicit-profile policy forbids; viable only as a reported scorecard

ideas.text: Complement cascade: ordered multi-step evidence amplification before defect acceptance
Scar-tissue annotation: repaired board regions carry persistent hash-bound markers forcing elevated check density and reviewer attention in all future candidates
Quorum sensing via secreted structured claims in the sealed evidence store
ideas.trap: adjudicator already sees all claims; a shared claim store risks reviewer isolation for no added signal

ideas.text: Hormetic bench dosing: low-dose off-nominal stress epochs whose margin response (hold vs collapse) widens or revokes trust
Chaperone pre-candidate lint: non-writing fast native validity pass over the implementation proposal that kills doomed edit sessions before a full review iteration is spent
ideas.correction: weighted score corrected from erroneous 7.75 (arithmetic: .35*7+.40*8+.25*8=7.65); flagged by coordinator in final confirmation; top-3 set/order unchanged (B6 remains 4th among non-traps)

clusters.prove-the-verifier: self-tests and audits of the trust machinery itself (canaries, falsifiability, independence monitoring)
clusters.spend-judgment-where-it-counts: pipeline economics: route expensive LLM judgment only where it changes outcomes
clusters.fail-legible-resume-safe: operability: failures explain themselves and name the safe next action
clusters.custody-beyond-hashes: physical/bench evidence provenance beyond byte hashes (calibration decay, raw re-derivation, stress dosing)
clusters.memory-without-contamination: compounding institutional memory while preserving reviewer independence
clusters.operator-as-player: the engineer as calibrated participant (predictions, decision screens, forks, acknowledgments)
